about: Firmware validated on a real FM-1: installed, run, and reverted to stock V15. Written by Claude Code sessions following VALIDATION.md (or by tools/fm1_validate.py); the dashboard only reads this file.

validations.checks: boots and plays; presets and the 4 knobs work; MIDI out notes (ch 1-3, 10) and clock seen; generic sound check 1-2 silent by design (ch 1 notes edit the scale); stock sound check 8/8 after revert
validations.notes: First revert via the AMB-1 installer's 'Back to the stock firmware' left a black screen in USB update mode (enumerated as generic USB-Midi 4D4A:4155); running it a second time restored stock V15.

validations.checks: sounds, keys and knobs work; generic sound check 1-4 heard (notes, channels, velocity, sustain); stock steps 1-4 also heard (notes, program change, reverb, distortion); keys sent as MIDI notes on ch 1; stock sound check passed after revert
validations.notes: Under Felucca the FM-1 shows up as MIDI port 'Felucca' (USB 1209:0001, shared with AMB-1) and ignores MIDI identity requests. Return to official V15 asks for the unmodified FM-1.fwsc and saves a full backup first; worked first time. Arpeggiator not figured out during the test.

validations.checks: force flash from stock V15 (FM-1_015) via the V13 workbench; groovebox runs: PLAY, presets, keys, 4 knobs (level, source, step, tempo); generic sound check 1-2 heard; no MIDI out seen; stock sound check passed after revert
validations.notes: Installing from stock needs the workbench's Force flash. Under Open the FM-1 enumerates as USB-Midi (3654:7756) and answers only the workbench's own handshake, not a MIDI identity request. Restore original V15 worked first time and also resets all four voice banks to the 128 factory voices.

validations.checks: installed twice as the revert target (AMB-1 installer's Back to the stock firmware; FM-1 Open workbench's Restore original V15); stock sound check 8/8: notes, program change, reverb, distortion, filter, SysEx voice, SysEx param, pitch bend
validations.notes: Stock is the revert target, so its revert step is coming back to it from community firmware. The library's FM-1.fwsc matches the stock V15 SHA256 that community installers check (db1642b2...).

validations.checks: played on the device; generic sound check 1-2 heard; stock sound check 8/8 after revert (run all)
validations.notes: Under SLOOP the FM-1's MIDI port is named 'Felucca' (USB 1209:0001, like Felucca and AMB-1). Generic step 1's notes started a looping take that kept playing until stopped: SLOOP is a live looper, so this looks like design. Return to the official firmware (V15) asks for the unmodified FM-1.fwsc; worked first time.
